remembrance: observed-in-code: list removal detaches links and decrements length (internal/list.go:95-104), then the map key is deleted (simplelru/lru.go:175-181). Purge deletes map keys and resets the list length (simplelru/lru.go:38-47, internal/list.go:49-55). Len counts list nodes (simplelru/lru.go:145-148), independently of capacity (simplelru/lru.go:150-165). With non-reflexive keys map deletion can fail. Single notifications reslice without clearing backing slots (lru.go:82-89, lru.go:131-138, lru.go:155-162, lru.go:172-179 and lru.go:208-215). Bulk paths detach the captured slices and allocate new buffers, then invoke user callbacks (lru.go:62-73 and lru.go:188-198). Scratch starts at 16 slots per slice (lru.go:12-15 and lru.go:46-49), can grow with a batch (lru.go:53-55) and has no time-based clearing. A delayed callback has the captured payload, may see a later generation, and is independent of list length. Measured heap retention is open.
lock_discipline: observed-in-code: Purge, Add, ContainsOrAdd, PeekOrAdd, Remove, Resize and RemoveOldest call the private capture hook inside the writer lock and invoke user callbacks after release (lru.go:62-73, lru.go:81-90, lru.go:126-139, lru.go:149-163, lru.go:171-180, lru.go:188-199 and lru.go:207-216). Get takes the writer lock to promote recency (lru.go:94-99, simplelru/lru.go:70-76). Contains, Peek, GetOldest, Keys, Values and Len use read locks and call no user code (lru.go:104-117 and lru.go:220-249). Cap has no lock (lru.go:252-255). User re-entry runs after unlock in every dispatch branch. The callback contract is silent on re-entry, concurrency and panic (lru.go:31-33 and simplelru/lru.go:12-13).
notes: Constructor calls create independent instances. A request reaches a particular cache by its receiver. Pairs model shared cache state or outputs with distinct actors. CallbackOutcome is the user code's outcome and CallbackDispatch is the cache's internal action. Two caller goroutines can also interleave within the API caller source.
